goal: Allows Bitcoin Core wallet users to send transactions to BIP 352 silent payment addresses
Brings enhanced on-chain privacy to everyday outgoing payments and fee-bumps
reviewability: Worth reviewing now because the conflicts with master are mechanical
agreement: Unaddressed objection: fee bumping after restoring a backup can cause missed payments (Yudis-bit)
Question on fee bumping adding inputs without recalculating outputs after backup restore (ValeraFinebits)
Verified compatibility by testing hundreds of transactions against another BIP 352 wallet (fametrano)
Concept approval without stated reasons (rkrux, w0xlt, rustaceanrob, polespinasa, davidgumberg)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it brings BIP 352 silent payment sending support to Bitcoin Core
Delivers a major privacy improvement for users creating and broadcasting transactions
